name: PDC 陶瓷气凝胶（综述参考文献）
purpose: Recall-only check with an expert-curated answer key: the research papers a 2021 review cites on polymer-derived ceramic aerogels.
question: 聚合物先驱体转化（PDC）路线制备的陶瓷气凝胶（SiOC、SiCN、SiOCN、SiBCN、SiC 等）：前驱体与凝胶化、干燥、热解与结构演变，以及隔热、吸波、储能、吸附、催化等应用。

source.curated: 2026-10-15; titles and abstracts read by the agent (missing abstracts fetched via Scopus); the user decided carbothermal-route aerogels are borderline, not targets

rules.target: research article on a ceramic aerogel made by the polymer-derived ceramic route, or on materials made from such an aerogel
rules.borderline: porous PDC that is not an aerogel, ceramic aerogels made by carbothermal reduction of hybrid gels, or route unknown; reported separately, not required
rules.excluded: reviews and books, background on dense PDC glasses, other aerogel families (silica, carbon, graphene, polymer, oxide), ceramic aerogels made by CVD, methods and theory
